products.title:
Therapeutic
solutions.
products.description: We are an Italian pharmaceutical company specialized in the research, development and commercialization of medical devices, food supplements and drugs. Our main objective is to offer innovative, safe and effective therapeutic solutions to patients and healthcare professionals, while creating new business opportunities for Italian and foreign pharmaceutical companies. We share with our partners solid know‑how built over the years, helping them develop their business worldwide.

dm.title:
Medical
Devices
dm.description: Medical devices are essential tools for the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of diseases, ensuring high standards of safety and effectiveness. Each specialty area requires dedicated solutions designed to meet the specific needs of physicians and patients.

ia.title:
Food
Supplements
ia.description: Food supplements are formulations of nutrients and other substances with a physiological effect (vitamins, minerals, botanical extracts, probiotics, fatty acids, amino acids) designed to support normal well‑being when diet alone is not sufficient to meet specific needs. They do not replace a balanced diet or medical therapies; their effectiveness depends on formulation, dosage, bioavailability and proper adherence.

farmaci.title: Drugs
farmaci.description: Drugs are substances with preventive, diagnostic or therapeutic action that act on specific biological processes to restore or modify body functions. Their quality, safety and efficacy are ensured through strict regulatory procedures (Marketing Authorization), production control (GMP) and post‑marketing monitoring (pharmacovigilance). Proper use requires medical prescription and supervision, adherence to dosage and duration, and attention to interactions and contraindications. Self‑medication is limited to OTC and non‑prescription drugs for mild and temporary disorders.

story.title: Milestones.
story.description:
Our story began in 1993 with a clear vision: bringing innovation to the medical device sector. Since our foundation, we have built a path of constant growth and internationalization.

Each milestone represents a step toward excellence. Our timeline shows how we became a leader in the sector, expanding across Europe and continuously innovating our production processes.

timeline.subtitle:
DMG ITALIA S.R.L. is founded by Luigi Mercuri and Antonio De Nisi.

Directive 93/42/EEC on medical devices (commonly referred to as MDD 93/42) is published in the Official Journal of the European Communities (OJEC).
Directive 93/42/EEC implemented in Italy by Legislative Decree No. 46 of 24 February 1997.
D.M.G. ITALIA pioneers the launch on the Italian market of RINOPANTEINA, the first CE-marked medical device that marks the entry of otorhinolaryngology into the D.M.G. ITALIA portfolio.
D.M.G. ITALIA signs its first international distribution agreement and, in the same year, relocates its headquarters from Rome to Pomezia, inaugurating its first production site: Italdevice.
Establishment of DMG Bulgaria, DMG Turkey and DMG Poland.
Transfer to current headquarters in Pomezia.
On 25 May 2017, the European Medical Device Regulation (MDR) entered into force, with 26 May 2021 as the date of application. It is intended to replace the MDD.
Major expansion of offices and production areas.

leadership.paragraph1: Our commitment, summarized in the payoff 'When care is needed', is constantly focused on improving people's quality of life and health. We promote an approach to healthcare based on the principle that we treat the patient, not just the disease.
leadership.paragraph2: Innovation, creativity and the constant search for new solutions are the pillars on which our Research and Development laboratories are built. They are composed of a team of professionals and equipped with state-of-the-art technologies that enable steady growth year after year.
leadership.paragraph3: Enthusiasm, integrity and the drive to innovate are the key qualities through which D.M.G. ITALIA fosters progress and the growth of its employees and collaborators, promoting a climate of transparency and inclusion.

international.title:
Our
International
Vocation
international.paragraph1: From a family-run company deeply rooted in the Italian territory, over the years we have evolved into a global organization, bringing our experience and vision to the world without ever losing the value of relationships. Since 2004, we have chosen to open up to international markets, embarking on a growth path that today sees us present in over 50 countries thanks to a strong and well-established network of Partners and Distributors.
international.paragraph2: Operating in diverse cultural contexts, we always work with sensitivity and respect for local specificities, offering flexibility in responding to the different needs of our Partners. Despite the distances, we ensure comprehensive and continuous support: from the development of marketing strategies to assistance with regulatory and medical-scientific matters, as well as dedicated training for the sales force. This collaborative approach has enabled us to build long-lasting relationships with many Distributors, based on trust, continuity and shared objectives.
international.paragraph3: We look to the future with the determination to continue expanding our international network. For this reason, we are always interested in connecting with new Partners who share our values and the desire to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions to patients worldwide.

researchDevelopment.title:
Research
 & Development
researchDevelopment.subtitle: ENGINE OF INNOVATION
researchDevelopment.heading: In our approach, research and strategic vision meet
paragraphs: In our approach, research and strategic vision meet to transform scientific innovation into concrete solutions.

The ability to generate original ideas, create new perspectives and transform them into real solutions leads us to develop new products and constantly improve our existing portfolio. These are the objectives of our R&D (Research and Development) department, which guides pharmaceutical innovation at D.M.G. Italia and to which an important share of annual revenues is allocated.

We rely on a multidisciplinary team of professionals who collaborate closely with external organizations such as Universities, Hospitals, Clinics and Research Centers and Laboratories equipped with specific and cutting-edge equipment. With our Partners we promote dialogue and the sharing of innovative resources and technologies, thanks to which we look to the future while preparing ourselves for the new challenges of the pharmaceutical sector.

Through the phases of planning, organization, control and analysis of results, our R&D team manages pioneering projects, essential for creating that added value that has allowed us to register more than 23 patents over the years and develop over 30 products in different pharmaceutical forms currently distributed in more than 50 countries worldwide.

farmacovigilanza.title: Pharmacovigilance
farmacovigilanza.subtitle: Drug Safety
farmacovigilanza.description: Pharmacovigilance collects and studies adverse reactions (harmful and unwanted effects resulting from the use of a drug) that may be associated with drug treatment, in order to:
cards: identify the causal relationship with drug use
identify possible risk factors for the onset of such adverse events
identify possible means of preventing adverse events themselves
farmacovigilanza.bottomText: When a drug is placed on the market, only the adverse reactions recorded during pre-registration clinical trials are known: such studies are generally conducted on a limited number of patients, belonging to selected categories. Only after its marketing, the drug is administered to a large number of various categories of patients and it is therefore possible to know more thoroughly the benefit/risk ratio related to the use of the drug itself. This is achieved through the systematic collection of adverse events and reactions. Spontaneous reporting by doctors, pharmacists, other healthcare professionals and by patients themselves is, therefore, essential to allow the Health Authorities responsible for Pharmacovigilance activities and Pharmaceutical Companies to define and keep updated the tolerability and safety profile of drugs (benefits versus risks) in real conditions of use.

sections.title: Medical Devices and Complaints
paragraphs: A technical complaint is defined pursuant to Legislative Decree 137/2022 as a communication declaring deficiencies related to the identity, quality, durability, reliability, usability, safety or performance of a device or relating to a service that affects the performance of such devices.

sections.title: Medical Devices and Incidents
paragraphs: An incident is any malfunction or alteration of the characteristics or performance of a Medical Device made available on the market, including user error determined by ergonomic characteristics, as well as any inadequacy in the information provided by the manufacturer and any undesirable side effects.

Current regulations indicate the obligations relating to the vigilance on Medical Devices and post-marketing surveillance borne by the Medical Device Manufacturer, including the collection of reports of suspected incidents and side effects.

certifiedCompany.title: D.M.G. ITALIA is a certified company for the research, development and trade of Medical Devices:

mdr.paragraph1: The new Medical Devices Regulation (MDR) 2017/745, which replaces the Directive (MDD) 93/42/EEC, entered into force on May 5, 2017. As of May 26, 2021, new medical devices placed on the market must comply with the requirements of the MDR, while medical devices previously certified under the Directive have been granted an extension of the validity of their Certificates until May 27, 2024.
mdr.paragraph2: With Regulation (EU) 2023/607 of the European Parliament and of the Council of March 15, 2023, an extension of the transition period has been granted, which introduces specific conditions under which certificates issued by Notified Bodies under the MDD and meeting the conditions of Regulation EU 2023/607 will remain valid until:
mdr.listItem1: a) December 31, 2027, for all class III devices and for implantable class IIb devices, subject to specifics;
mdr.listItem2: b) December 31, 2028, for class IIb devices other than those referred to in letter a) of this paragraph, for class IIa devices and for class I devices placed on the market in sterile conditions or with a measuring function.
mdr.paragraph3: D.M.G. ITALIA, as Legal Manufacturer, guarantees the compliance of its Medical Devices according to both the Directive and the European Regulation.
